decision: Original direct strict paired success on new rotations increased from 6.6% at 8000 to 25.4% at 16000 and 44.1% at 32000. Continue the ordinary uniformly weighted optimizer; do not choose an individual or change the architecture.
primary: 32000 versus 64000 Adam updates on the same six original trajectories; make the same comparison on six independently initialized trajectories with different training streams. True triple margins must exceed .05 for both +++ and --- and are scored in both sensory orientations.
order_check: Six presentation orders of the same physical odors with each object's draws and orientation following its identity. Report typical single-order pass and the stricter all-six-orders pass separately. Also require success on all eight independent label maps to rule out trading the six other maps away.
budget: 32000 additional updates after the recorded 32000-step Adam state; total 64000 triangle updates per birth.
